name: nestpilot-retirement
description: Free retirement-decision copilot from NestPilot Foundation: Medicare timing, Social Security claiming, the Roth conversion window, and retirement-age viability — plus plan-backed forecasting and a guided retirement checkup. Bundles the public NestPilot MCP tools; no account required.

interface.shortDescription: Educational retirement checkups with visible assumptions
interface.longDescription: Open anonymous retirement review tools whose calculations run only after explicit UI clicks. The persistent checkup coordinates retirement-age, Social Security, and Roth analyses one at a time and keeps every completed result in tabs. An optional planner CTA carries the complete plan through a temporary single-use handoff; no account or transaction is created.
defaultPrompt: Can I afford to retire? Guide me through a complete checkup and show the assumptions.
Compare my possible retirement ages and explain how Social Security timing changes the result.
Find my Roth conversion window and show how Medicare timing could affect it.
